resources.string: Aborting may discard changes made while resolving this operation. Review your draft and working tree first.
Every change opens a confirmation. Saving a file, staging, committing, and pushing are separate actions.
This reads the repository and clears the local pending marker. It does not repeat the operation or prove that a remote push succeeded. Verify the remote separately before starting a new operation.
Binary content changed; textual diff is unavailable.
Text editing is unavailable. Choose a complete side or explicitly delete the file.
Commit all staged content. Unstaged edits remain in the working tree.
Review the target and changes. Current facts and diff versions will be checked again before execution.
This file is no longer in the current conflict list. Your result draft is retained for review; no further resolution will be submitted from this editor.
Compare the three versions and choose a result. Edited content must contain no conflict markers. Refreshing the revision preserves your draft; review it against the new versions before saving.
The host needs Git credentials. Configure host authentication before starting a new operation. Credential details are not shown here.
The conflicted file will be deleted and the deletion staged.
HEAD is detached. Switch to a branch before pulling or pushing.
The repository or conflict revision changed. Read current facts and review before confirming again.
I have independently identified %1$s as the original Git installation. Associate it with the pending request and read its current state.
Ordinary host execution is unavailable for this identity. Repository changes are disabled.
Install Git with the host package manager. This creates a recoverable installation task and may request host elevation.
A Git installation is active or needs recovery. Repository writes are paused.
Installation status has not been verified.
Commit messages can contain at most 16384 characters.
No readable text (absent, binary, or too large)
Push to the configured upstream. Verify the branch and upstream above.
The operation receipt was received and current facts were read back.
Git rejected the operation. Current repository facts are shown; no operation was replayed.
This explicit retry uses the original durable request key and unchanged Git installation options. It first queries active tasks; an active task alone is not proof that it belongs to this request.
The displayed patch is truncated. Review the full file before confirming.
Further changes to this repository are paused. Read current facts and compare them with the intended result. Remote changes cannot be proven by local status alone.
Current facts could not be verified. Refresh before changing the repository.
